{{Top|leg}}
The '''Eriadu Free HoloDaily''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news agency based at [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]]. It covered the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] held<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> [[Eru Matalis]], the leader of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], apparently worked for it at some point before the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]].<ref name="CoD" />
